# Mixed Encoding Attributes

A vector dataset whose attribute table contains text in multiple character encodings (UTF-8, Latin-1, Windows-1252). Exposes encoding-related failures in column parsing.

## Use this case

```python
import pytest
```

## What this case checks

Detect loaders that assume a single encoding or silently corrupt non-ASCII attribute values.

## Risk types covered

- [`attribute_loss`](../risk/attribute-loss.md)
- [`encoding_error`](../risk/encoding-error.md)
- [`mojibake`](../risk/mojibake.md)
